name: mires-library-matrix
description: Library x compiler matrix: npm libraries ported to nine compiled languages, checked for exact parity, sized and timed.

scripts.all: npm run build && npm run check && npm run bench && npm run sizes && npm run matrix
scripts.pilot: node tools/build.mjs --library pilot,floor --language all && node tools/check.mjs --library pilot,floor && node tools/bench.mjs --library pilot && node tools/sizes.mjs && node tools/matrix.mjs
